name: goutorbe-global-heat-flow-2011
title: Goutorbe et al. (2011) global heat flow and geophysical proxies
description: Original supplementary table on a global 1-degree grid: observed heat flow, similarity and best-combination estimates with standard deviations, and geological and geophysical proxies. RESKit geothermal preprocessing uses Similarity method: mean HF (mW/m2) and Heat prod (provinces) (uW/m3). The complete original table is retained, including its explanatory header.

sources.title: Goutorbe et al. (2011), Global heat flow trends resolved from multiple geological and geophysical proxies, supplementary material
Use in Franzmann et al. (2025), Global geothermal electricity potentials, section 2.3, equation (1)
